recaps.title: To You, in 2000 Years: The Fall of Shiganshina, Part 1
recaps.safeSummary: For 100 years, humanity lived in peaceful isolation behind three gigantic concentric walls: Maria, Rose, and Sheena. In the outer district of Shiganshina, young Eren Yeager dreams of seeing the outside world, frustrating his mother Carla. Suddenly, lightning strikes and a colossal 60-meter Titan kicks a catastrophic breach in Wall Maria. Titans swarm the town, and Eren watches helplessly as his mother is trapped and eaten, igniting his eternal pledge to wipe out every Titan.
bullets: Humanity has lived sheltered behind 50-meter walls for a century believing they were safe.
The Colossal Titan appears out of thin air and shatters Wall Maria's front gate.
Eren's mother Carla is trapped beneath their collapsed house and killed.
Hannes rescues Eren and Mikasa as they escape on the refugee evacuation boats.
majorEvents: Wall Maria breached by the Colossal Titan
Eren's vow to eradicate all Titans
unresolvedQuestions: Where did the Colossal Titan come from and how did it appear without warning?
What is inside the basement that Eren's father Dr. Grisha Yeager hid?
recaps.cliffhanger: Eren looks back at the burning ruins of his home from the evacuation boat, sobbing with fury and swearing total vengeance.
